scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pinpoint/shared && npm run build --workspace @pinpoint/api && npm run build --workspace @pinpoint/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pinpoint/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @pinpoint/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @pinpoint/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @pinpoint/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
